You are an illustrator who writes SVG by hand.

Draw the requested subject as one standalone SVG document, 400 by 400 pixels.
Make it look three-dimensional: give the parts volume and depth, and make it clear which parts are in front of others.
Use only what SVG itself provides. Do not use scripts, external images, external fonts or links.
Reply with the SVG document only: no explanation and no Markdown code fence.
Draw this: a cat sitting down.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="bgGrad" cx="50%" cy="55%" r="55%" fx="50%" fy="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f2f4f8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d5dce6"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Floor Shadow Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="floorShadow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#606d80" stop-opacity="0.45"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#606d80" stop-opacity="0.2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#606d80" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Main Body 3D Fur Gradient (Lit from top-left) -->
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="65%" fx="30%" fy="25%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffaa4c"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#e87a24"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#bd5110"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9c3d07"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Head 3D Sphere Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="headGrad" cx="40%" cy="32%" r="60%" fx="32%" fy="25%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffba66"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ee8329"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#c45712"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9c3d07"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Front Legs Cylinder Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="legLeftGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffb35c"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ea7d26"/>
      <stop offset="90%" stop-color="#b54b0e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8f3605"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="legRightGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f58b32"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#de701d"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#a84209"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#802e03"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- White Fur (Chest, Paws, Muzzle) 3D Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="whiteFur" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="65%" fx="35%" fy="25%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#f7efe6"/>
      <stop offset="88%" stop-color="#decab8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c7b09b"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Ear Interior Depth Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="earInside" x1="20%" y1="0%" x2="80%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f09ca2"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#d46e78"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#963945"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Eye 3D Marble Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="eyeGrad" cx="60%" cy="65%" r="55%" fx="65%" fy="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a8ed3e"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#48b82e"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#146923"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#083b12"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Pink Nose Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="noseGrad" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff9ea6"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#e05a68"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9e2a37"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Tail Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="tailGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a34008"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#d96b1b"/>
      <stop offset="80%" stop-color="#ffaa4c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Soft Drop Shadow Filter for Layer Separation -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="130%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#421802" flood-opacity="0.38"/>
    </filter>
    
    <filter id="subtleShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#421802" flood-opacity="0.28"/>
    </filter>

    <filter id="pawShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="2.5" flood-color="#1f2630" flood-opacity="0.4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>

  <!-- Ambient Floor Shadow (Back) -->
  <ellipse cx="205" cy="342" rx="115" ry="26" fill="url(#floorShadow)"/>
  <!-- Contact Shadow (Darker, tighter) -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="344" rx="75" ry="14" fill="url(#floorShadow)"/>

  <!-- LAYER 1: TAIL (Behind Body, Sweeping to the Front Right) -->
  <g id="tail" filter="url(#pawShadow)">
    <!-- Main Tail Volume -->
    <path d="M 248 318 
             C 305 322, 348 285, 340 245 
             C 334 218, 305 215, 300 235 
             C 295 255, 315 268, 298 288 
             C 285 303, 260 302, 245 300 Z" 
          fill="url(#tailGrad)"/>
    <!-- Tail Stripes (Clipped implicitly by placement) -->
    <path d="M 294 311 C 298 302, 305 300, 312 304 C 306 309, 299 311, 294 311 Z" fill="#8f3405" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M 320 295 C 320 284, 326 279, 335 282 C 331 289, 326 293, 320 295 Z" fill="#8f3405" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M 337 268 C 331 259, 333 252, 341 251 C 341 258, 340 264, 337 268 Z" fill="#8f3405" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- LAYER 2: TORSO & HINDQUARTERS -->
  <g id="torso">
    <!-- Main Body Pear Shape -->
    <path d="M 155 170 
             C 118 205, 102 268, 118 315 
             C 128 340, 165 344, 195 344 
             C 225 344, 262 340, 272 315 
             C 288 268, 272 205, 235 170 Z" 
          fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>

    <!-- Body Tiger Stripes (Left & Right Flanks) -->
    <g fill="#8f3405" opacity="0.45">
      <path d="M 125 225 C 142 230, 152 242, 146 248 C 138 245, 128 238, 122 233 Z"/>
      <path d="M 115 252 C 138 258, 148 272, 140 278 C 130 274, 118 266, 113 260 Z"/>
      <path d="M 265 225 C 248 230, 238 242, 244 248 C 252 245, 262 238, 268 233 Z"/>
      <path d="M 275 252 C 252 258, 242 272, 250 278 C 260 274, 272 266, 277 260 Z"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Crease Shadow separating Hind Legs from Torso -->
    <path d="M 136 262 C 122 282, 125 312, 145 328" fill="none" stroke="#853004" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M 254 262 C 268 282, 265 312, 245 328" fill="none" stroke="#6e2602" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

    <!-- Back Paws (Tucked in behind front paws) -->
    <ellipse cx="130" cy="336" rx="22" ry="11" transform="rotate(-8 130 336)" fill="url(#whiteFur)" filter="url(#pawShadow)"/>
    <ellipse cx="260" cy="336" rx="22" ry="11" transform="rotate(8 260 336)" fill="url(#whiteFur)" filter="url(#pawShadow)"/>
    <!-- Back Paw Toe Creases -->
    <path d="M 118 338 C 120 333, 124 333, 125 338" fill="none" stroke="#b09780" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 127 340 C 129 335, 133 335, 134 340" fill="none" stroke="#b09780" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 272 338 C 270 333, 266 333, 265 338" fill="none" stroke="#b09780" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 263 340 C 261 335, 257 335, 256 340" fill="none" stroke="#b09780" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- LAYER 3: CHEST RUFF & FRONT LEGS (In Front of Torso) -->
  <!-- Shadow cast by Front Legs onto the Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="295" rx="44" ry="48" fill="#5e2002" opacity="0.45"/>

  <g id="frontLegs">
    <!-- Left Front Leg (Viewer's Left - Brighter) -->
    <path d="M 150 205 
             C 146 245, 152 295, 156 338 
             L 188 338 
             C 190 295, 193 250, 190 210 Z" 
          fill="url(#legLeftGrad)" filter="url(#subtleShadow)"/>
          
    <!-- Right Front Leg (Viewer's Right - Slightly Shaded) -->
    <path d="M 240 205 
             C 244 245, 238 295, 234 338 
             L 202 338 
             C 200 295, 197 250, 200 210 Z" 
          fill="url(#legRightGrad)" filter="url(#subtleShadow)"/>

    <!-- Leg Stripes -->
    <g fill="#8c3506" opacity="0.4">
      <path d="M 151 265 C 162 270, 175 270, 188 265 C 178 274, 162 274, 151 265 Z"/>
      <path d="M 153 285 C 164 290, 176 290, 188 285 C 178 294, 163 294, 153 285 Z"/>
      <path d="M 239 265 C 228 270, 215 270, 202 265 C 212 274, 228 274, 239 265 Z"/>
      <path d="M 237 285 C 226 290, 214 290, 202 285 C 212 294, 227 294, 237 285 Z"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Fluffy White Chest Bib (Overlapping top of legs) -->
    <path d="M 154 178 
             C 146 205, 155 245, 195 256 
             C 235 245, 244 205, 236 178 Z" 
          fill="url(#whiteFur)" filter="url(#subtleShadow)"/>
    <!-- Chest Fur Texture Tufts -->
    <path d="M 172 248 L 168 255 L 178 251 M 195 255 L 195 263 L 201 255 M 218 248 L 222 255 L 212 251" 
          fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>

    <!-- Front Left Paw (3D Rounded Puff) -->
    <g filter="url(#pawShadow)">
      <path d="M 152 332 
               C 145 338, 147 352, 162 353 
               C 175 354, 186 353, 191 346 
               C 194 340, 190 332, 185 330 Z" 
            fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>
      <path d="M 163 352 C 162 342, 165 338, 167 338" fill="none" stroke="#b89f88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M 176 352 C 176 342, 178 338, 180 338" fill="none" stroke="#b89f88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Front Right Paw (3D Rounded Puff) -->
    <g filter="url(#pawShadow)">
      <path d="M 238 332 
               C 245 338, 243 352, 228 353 
               C 215 354, 204 353, 199 346 
               C 196 340, 200 332, 205 330 Z" 
            fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>
      <path d="M 227 352 C 228 342, 225 338, 223 338" fill="none" stroke="#b89f88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M 214 352 C 214 342, 212 338, 210 338" fill="none" stroke="#b89f88" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- LAYER 4: HEAD & FACE (Frontmost Volume, Casts Shadow on Chest) -->
  <g id="headGroup" filter="url(#dropShadow)">
    
    <!-- Left Ear -->
    <g id="leftEar">
      <!-- Outer Ear -->
      <path d="M 134 128 
               C 118 95, 114 64, 123 57 
               C 132 50, 164 72, 178 96 Z" 
            fill="url(#headGrad)"/>
      <!-- Inner Ear Recess -->
      <path d="M 136 118 
               C 125 94, 122 70, 127 65 
               C 133 61, 154 77, 166 96 Z" 
            fill="url(#earInside)"/>
      <!-- Ear Rim Highlight/Thickness -->
      <path d="M 134 124 C 121 94, 118 66, 125 60" fill="none" stroke="#ffca85" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
      <!-- Ear Furnishings (Tufts) -->
      <path d="M 142 114 C 148 106, 158 106, 162 100 C 154 100, 146 102, 138 108 Z" fill="#fff5eb" opacity="0.85"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Right Ear -->
    <g id="rightEar">
      <!-- Outer Ear -->
      <path d="M 256 128 
               C 272 95, 276 64, 267 57 
               C 258 50, 226 72, 212 96 Z" 
            fill="url(#headGrad)"/>
      <!-- Inner Ear Recess -->
      <path d="M 254 118 
               C 265 94, 268 70, 263 65 
               C 257 61, 236 77, 224 96 Z" 
            fill="url(#earInside)"/>
      <!-- Ear Shadowed Rim -->
      <path d="M 216 95 C 230 75, 256 55, 265 60" fill="none" stroke="#9c3d07" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
      <!-- Ear Furnishings (Tufts) -->
      <path d="M 248 114 C 242 106, 232 106, 228 100 C 236 100, 244 102, 252 108 Z" fill="#f5e3d3" opacity="0.85"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Main Cranium & Cheeks (3D Squashed Sphere) -->
    <path d="M 195 82 
             C 150 82, 126 112, 122 145 
             C 117 180, 148 205, 195 205 
             C 242 205, 273 180, 268 145 
             C 264 112, 240 82, 195 82 Z" 
          fill="url(#headGrad)"/>

    <!-- Forehead Tabby Markings ('M' Shape & Cheek Swirls) -->
    <g fill="#8c3204" opacity="0.55">
      <!-- Center M -->
      <path d="M 176 118 C 178 102, 184 96, 188 108 C 192 94, 198 94, 202 108 C 206 96, 212 102, 214 118 C 210 108, 205 106, 202 115 C 198 104, 192 104, 188 115 C 185 106, 180 108, 176 118 Z"/>
      <path d="M 195 84 C 193 92, 193 98, 195 104 C 197 98, 197 92, 195 84 Z"/>
      <!-- Left Cheek Stripes -->
      <path d="M 124 148 C 135 152, 146 150, 152 146 C 145 154, 134 157, 123 154 Z"/>
      <path d="M 126 162 C 138 167, 150 165, 156 159 C 148 169, 136 172, 125 168 Z"/>
      <!-- Right Cheek Stripes -->
      <path d="M 266 148 C 255 152, 244 150, 238 146 C 245 154, 256 157, 267 154 Z"/>
      <path d="M 264 162 C 252 167, 240 165, 234 159 C 242 169, 254 172, 265 168 Z"/>
    </g>

    <!-- White Muzzle Blaze (Under Nose) -->
    <path d="M 195 148 
             C 178 148, 156 164, 158 182 
             C 160 198, 178 204, 195 204 
             C 212 204, 230 198, 232 182 
             C 234 164, 212 148, 195 148 Z" 
          fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>

    <!-- EYES (Deep set with 3D sockets and glossy corneas) -->
    <!-- Left Eye -->
    <g id="leftEye">
      <!-- Eye Socket Shadow / Eyeliner -->
      <path d="M 144 142 C 148 125, 174 127, 179 146 C 173 159, 149 158, 144 142 Z" fill="#4f1c02"/>
      <!-- Eyeball Surface -->
      <path d="M 147 142 C 150 128, 172 130, 176 145 C 171 156, 151 155, 147 142 Z" fill="url(#eyeGrad)"/>
      <!-- Internal Shadow under upper lid (gives cornea depth) -->
      <path d="M 147 142 C 150 128, 172 130, 176 145 C 172 135, 151 134, 147 142 Z" fill="#05260b" opacity="0.6"/>
      <!-- Vertical Pupil -->
      <ellipse cx="162" cy="143" rx="3.8" ry="11" fill="#09140b"/>
      <!-- Main Specular Highlight (Top Left) -->
      <circle cx="157" cy="137" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <circle cx="154" cy="141" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
      <!-- Secondary Bounce Highlight (Bottom Right) -->
      <ellipse cx="167" cy="149" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" transform="rotate(-25 167 149)" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Right Eye -->
    <g id="rightEye">
      <!-- Eye Socket Shadow / Eyeliner -->
      <path d="M 246 142 C 242 125, 216 127, 211 146 C 217 159, 241 158, 246 142 Z" fill="#4f1c02"/>
      <!-- Eyeball Surface -->
      <path d="M 243 142 C 240 128, 218 130, 214 145 C 219 156, 239 155, 243 142 Z" fill="url(#eyeGrad)"/>
      <!-- Internal Shadow under upper lid -->
      <path d="M 243 142 C 240 128, 218 130, 214 145 C 218 135, 239 134, 243 142 Z" fill="#05260b" opacity="0.6"/>
      <!-- Vertical Pupil -->
      <ellipse cx="228" cy="143" rx="3.8" ry="11" fill="#09140b"/>
      <!-- Main Specular Highlight (Top Left) -->
      <circle cx="223" cy="137" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <circle cx="220" cy="141" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
      <!-- Secondary Bounce Highlight (Bottom Right) -->
      <ellipse cx="233" cy="149" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" transform="rotate(-25 233 149)" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 3D MUZZLE & NOSE BRIDGE (Protruding forward) -->
    <!-- Nose Bridge Highlight -->
    <path d="M 188 135 C 188 145, 185 155, 185 160 L 205 160 C 205 155, 202 145, 202 135 Z" fill="#ffca85" opacity="0.35"/>

    <!-- Chin (Underneath Mouth) -->
    <path d="M 179 184 C 185 196, 205 196, 211 184 C 204 188, 186 188, 179 184 Z" fill="#d4beaa"/>

    <!-- Puffy Whisker Pads (Peanut shape overlapping the chin) -->
    <g filter="url(#subtleShadow)">
      <!-- Left Pad -->
      <path d="M 195 162 
               C 182 156, 164 162, 164 175 
               C 164 186, 184 189, 195 177 Z" 
            fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>
      <!-- Right Pad -->
      <path d="M 195 162 
               C 208 156, 226 162, 226 175 
               C 226 186, 206 189, 195 177 Z" 
            fill="url(#whiteFur)"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Mouth Crease -->
    <path d="M 195 169 L 195 177 M 195 177 C 189 184, 178 185, 173 179 M 195 177 C 201 184, 212 185, 217 179" 
          fill="none" stroke="#6e473b" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <!-- Nose (3D Button) -->
    <g filter="url(#subtleShadow)">
      <path d="M 184 160 
               C 184 156, 206 156, 206 160 
               C 206 165, 199 172, 195 172 
               C 191 172, 184 165, 184 160 Z" 
            fill="url(#noseGrad)"/>
      <!-- Nose Specular Highlight -->
      <ellipse cx="192" cy="160" rx="4.5" ry="1.8" transform="rotate(-8 192 160)" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Whiskers (Curving outward in 3D space) -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85">
      <!-- Left Whiskers -->
      <path d="M 172 172 C 142 168, 112 174, 88 184" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <path d="M 170 176 C 140 176, 110 185, 86 198" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="M 173 180 C 148 184, 122 196, 102 210" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <!-- Right Whiskers -->
      <path d="M 218 172 C 248 168, 278 174, 302 184" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <path d="M 220 176 C 250 176, 280 185, 304 198" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="M 217 180 C 242 184, 268 196, 288 210" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <!-- Eyebrow Whiskers -->
      <path d="M 156 124 C 146 110, 132 104, 120 106" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
      <path d="M 234 124 C 244 110, 258 104, 270 106" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    </g>

  </g>
</svg>
